question: What does the idiom 'On cloud nine' mean?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2) Extremely happy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"On cloud nine"** means being in a state of extreme happiness and elation. It represents a feeling of great joy or ecstasy. (बेहद खुश)

 
 
• **Example:** She was on cloud nine after receiving a promotion at work.
 
 
 
• **"Extremely happy"** refers to a state of intense joy and contentment. (अत्यधिक खुश)
 
 
• **Example:** He was extremely happy to reunite with his childhood friends after a decade.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom "On cloud nine" is correctly associated with the meaning "Extremely happy."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2) Extremely happy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lazy** (आलसी): Unwilling to work or use energy.

 
 
• **Example:** He is so lazy that he avoids even simple household chores.
 
 
 
• **Very angry** (बहुत गुस्सा): In a state of strong displeasure or rage.
 
 
• **Example:** She was very angry when she found out someone had scratched her car.
 
 
 
• **Confused** (भ्रमित): Unable to think clearly or understand something.
 
 
• **Example:** He looked confused when the teacher explained the complex math problem.
 
 

57:Ta1c,

The correct answer is option 1.</stro
